rationale: C04 is a direct, highly specific drafting template for the child. Both directives modify the same three-year limitation under the same earlier executive order for a named former Federal Communications Commission employee serving with the International Telecommunication Union; both substitute a five-year termination-without-prejudice condition and retain compliance with all other reemployment provisions. The child closely reproduces C04's language and operative structure while changing the employee and organizational placement. C11 and C20 concern reemployment rights but lack this distinctive machinery and wording.
